tickets.title: Compare Teacup Comet refinance quote vs. variable HELOC
tickets.text: Compare the Teacup Comet Bank fixed-rate refinance quote against keeping the variable home-equity line for Liora and Daren Copperwisp, including payment, closing costs, and cash-flow effect. The current HELOC is $96,000 at 8.75% variable with interest-only payments near $700 monthly.
tickets.evidence: Agreed by 2025-07-25: compare the Teacup Comet fixed-rate refinance quote with keeping the variable home-equity line, including payment, closing costs, cash-flow effect.

tickets.title: Prepare debt-priority schedule for Copperwisp debts
tickets.text: Prepare a debt-priority schedule for Liora and Daren Copperwisp weighing Daren's business line moving off promotional pricing, the $96,000 Teacup Comet Bank home-equity line at 8.75% variable, and the $18,400 credit-card balance before the higher payment begins.
tickets.evidence: Agreed by 2025-08-08: a debt-priority schedule weighing Daren’s business line moving off promotional pricing, the home-equity line, and the $18,400 credit-card balance before the higher payment begins.
